import pyautogui, time

# ensure VSCode is focused
time.sleep(0.5)
# go to line 2
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.write('2')
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
# move to start of line
pyautogui.press('home')
time.sleep(0.2)
# select through line 10 (8 shifts)
for _ in range(8):
    pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'down')
    time.sleep(0.1)
# indent selection
pyautogui.press('tab')
